TP.REFORMULATION: Change to an equivalent or more revealing representation before attacking the original form.
TP.LINEARIZATION: Transform or compare objects so that nonlinear structure reduces to linear structure.
TP.LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL: Derive a global conclusion from local constraints, compatibility, or repeated local relations.
TP.EXTREMALIZATION: Choose an extremal object or parameter so that the extremal property forces structure.
TP.MINIMAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Assume failure, choose a minimal bad object, and construct a smaller bad object or contradiction.
TP.INVARIANT: Identify a quantity or structure preserved by the allowed transformation or process.
TP.MONOTONICITY: Track an ordered quantity that moves in only one direction and use boundedness or extremality.
TP.SYMMETRY_BREAKING: Fix a representative, direction, label, or normalization to remove redundant symmetry.
TP.ENCODING: Replace the original objects by a more useful combinatorial, algebraic, geometric, or graph representation.
TP.DECOMPOSITION_RECONSTRUCTION: Split an object into controlled pieces, solve or count locally, then reconstruct the whole.
TP.DUAL_COUNTING: Evaluate the same finite structure in two aggregation orders or from two incidence viewpoints.
TP.DESCENT: Produce a strictly smaller or simpler object of the same forbidden type and iterate or contradict well-ordering.
